0022600001.text: The Detroit Pistons host the Boston Celtics in a regular-season game where both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with neither side having played yet this year. Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, and the most recent meeting, on January 19, 2026, in Detroit, went the Pistons' way 104-103. Boston's Derrick White, Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta, Payton Pritchard, and Sam Hauser are all day-to-day with rest listed as the reason and are game-time decisions, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Detroit a 50% chance to win.
